title: Changing Tiers Within Northgate+
content:
**Terms.** A member of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships may move between paid tiers whose entry gates they meet, and the new tier, billing cycle and fee take effect on the next renewal date. A move to Northgate+ Assist or Northgate+ Student requires the tier's eligibility proof to be confirmed first. Business and consumer tiers are not interchangeable because their customer types differ, and leaving a paid tier for Northgate Rewards is a cancellation, not a plan change. Every tier change takes effect under the tier's change setting, the next renewal date.

**Status.** A tier can be changed only while the membership is in trial or active status; the status is read from the membership record.

| Membership status | Tier change possible |
|---|---|
| trial | yes |
| active | yes |
| enrolled, payment hold, cancel pending or canceled | no |

**Re-verification.** Northgate+ Assist and Northgate+ Student eligibility must be re-verified every re-verification period of months counted from the date eligibility was verified; a re-verification not completed by the first renewal date on or after that anniversary moves the membership to the tier's fallback tier at that renewal.

**Student limit.** A Northgate+ Student membership moves to Northgate+ Monthly at the renewal on which its student months reach the tier's maximum discounted months. Student months are the number of settled membership fee charges, on any membership record of the customer, whose tier at the charge is Northgate+ Student, over the customer's whole membership history up to the date being evaluated.

**Worked re-verification date (hypothetical, 12-month period).** Eligibility verified on 20 August 2031 reaches its anniversary on 20 August 2032. For a monthly renewal on the 25th, the first renewal date on or after that anniversary is 25 August 2032; a re-verification not completed by then moves the membership to the fallback tier at that renewal.

**Basis Q&A**

*A Northgate+ Annual member asks to switch to Northgate Rewards.* That is a cancellation, not a plan change.

*A Northgate+ Business member asks to move to Northgate+ Monthly.* Business and consumer tiers are not interchangeable.
